base inertials are platform-sw CAD-export placeholders, the mast mass is a placeholder and the arm masses are upstream nominal values; none of them is a measured mass
T05 asserts the identity height(openarm_left_base_link) = shoulder_height(mast_id), which holds for any datum values; it does not validate the datums themselves

E01 is WARN, never PASS: height, width and depth are lower bounds from zero pose, link frame origins and box/cylinder/sphere extents; mesh extents are not included, so a figure under the limit proves nothing about the real envelope. A4 decides
T10 reports what the description models. The battery, hub motors, electronics and the mast structure are not modelled (all F2S), so the total is not the gross mass of the robot

T14, T15 and T16 are expansion checks: nothing loads the gazebo or the real plugin. gz_ros2_control's handling of the finger_joint2 mimic is a TODO (upstream leaves it out of ros2_control), and the real profile cannot even be built here (openarm_hardware needs OpenArmCAN)

the gripper controllers are the deprecated position_controllers/GripperActionController on purpose: the replacement serves ParallelGripperCommand instead of GripperCommand, which would decide manipulation#11 / ADR-009 point 4 (open)
L01 launches mock.launch.py only: controller_manager on mock_components/GenericSystem, which reflects its command back as state, so it shows the controller wiring and not tracking performance
T02 check_urdf parses the XML and builds the link tree; it does not resolve package:// mesh URIs
W01: KDL consumers (robot_state_publisher, MoveIt in A7) do not see base_link's inertia

W02: with enable_planar_base:=true KDL consumers see world -> base_link as static; planar base motion can never come from robot_state_publisher (A7: it comes from Gazebo's odom -> base_link, ADR-003 / ADR-005)
V01: no human has looked at an RViz window; nothing in this report is a visual inspection
config ids are hashes of xacro's output text: a different xacro version that formats a number differently gives a different id for the same sources

`static+mock` names the evidence class: expansions of every hardware_profile, plus a headless launch of the mock bringup (L01) and the robot_state_publisher observation for W02. Nothing ran on Gazebo or real hardware
no physical evidence; static expansion and zero-pose FK only
